decision.explanation: Document d1 explicitly states Thomas Beyer received the Karl-Preusker-Medaille in 2005 for contributions to the German library system, while Document d2 explicitly describes him receiving the Prix Médicis for his novel 'Les Échos de la Mémoire'; although these claims are mutually exclusive regarding real-world plausibility for a single individual, both are presented as factual assertions within the provided text sources without internal contradiction.
